resources.string: Arty can show and search received SMS from the last 7 days on this phone, only when you open the SMS screen. These are the phone\'s messages, not a separate mailbox for your Arty account. Messages stay in the Android screen: no transfer to Arty servers, AI providers, chat or backups. Arty cannot send, delete or mark them as read. Your choice lasts for this app session and can be withdrawn in Connections → SMS. You can continue using Arty if you decline. Android will also ask for permission if necessary.
Received SMS · Last 7 days · Up to 50 results. No AI or synchronization. RCS and MMS are not included. Long messages are truncated at 4,000 characters.
